label: Isolated-cell detection
title: Under isolated-cell detection, closure is not commute-or-collapse: two rules close with a non-constant factor that is not the rule
kind: Exact audit of a second non-linear observation, with a failed frozen prediction
summary: Rule 4 as an observation closes exactly 33 rules at every ring 6 to 12: 9 exact commuters, 24 collapse rules, and rules 123 and 251, whose induced factor is neither constant nor the rule. Rule 251 is the complement of the observation itself, so its observed successor is determined by the observation by construction; rule 123 is not, and only shares that observed successor on the tested rings. The frozen commute-or-collapse prediction failed. Complement conjugation is covariant only when the observation is transported with the rule.
takeaway: Closure under a non-linear observation is not exhausted by commutation and collapse, and a property that is not invariant can still be exactly covariant once the contract travels with the rule.
